Remote and Hybrid Working Policy (HR-POL-012) — Preamble
HR-POL-012 Remote and Hybrid Working Policy
Northwind Talent Ltd | People Operations | Version 3.0 | Effective 15 January 2026

Remote and Hybrid Working Policy (HR-POL-012) — 1. Purpose and scope
This policy explains how employees of Northwind Talent Ltd may work remotely or on a hybrid pattern. It applies to all
permanent and fixed-term employees in the UK, the Netherlands and India. Contractors are covered by their own
agreements and are out of scope.
The policy owner is the Head of People Operations. Questions should be raised with your HR Business Partner or
through the People Helpdesk.

Remote and Hybrid Working Policy (HR-POL-012) — 2. Hybrid working pattern
The default pattern is hybrid: a minimum of two days per week in the office (anchor days are Tuesday and Thursday)
and up to three days working from home. Teams may agree a different anchor day with their Director, provided at least
40% of working time is spent in the office averaged over a calendar month.
Fully remote contracts are by exception only and require approval from the relevant Director and the Head of People
Operations.

Remote and Hybrid Working Policy (HR-POL-012) — 3. Working from another country
Employees may work temporarily from a country other than their country of employment for up to 20 working days in any
rolling 12-month period. This is known as Temporary Overseas Working.
Requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least 15 working days before travel using form HR-F-031.
Approval is required from your line manager, the Tax team and Information Security. Some countries are excluded
because of tax, immigration or data-protection risk; the current list is maintained on the People intranet.
Working from abroad for longer than 20 days, or on a recurring basis, is treated as an international assignment and is
handled by the Global Mobility team.

Remote and Hybrid Working Policy (HR-POL-012) — 4. Home office equipment and allowance
New joiners receive a laptop, monitor, keyboard and headset. In addition, employees on a hybrid or remote pattern may
claim a one-off home office allowance of GBP 300 (UK), EUR 350 (Netherlands) or INR 20,000 (India) for a desk, chair
or lighting. Receipts must be submitted within 60 days through the expenses system under category HOME-EQUIP.
A monthly connectivity allowance of GBP 25 / EUR 25 / INR 1,500 is paid through payroll to employees who work from
home at least two days per week.

Remote and Hybrid Working Policy (HR-POL-012) — 5. Health, safety and security
Employees must complete the Display Screen Equipment (DSE) self-assessment within the first month of hybrid working
and repeat it every two years. Company devices must only be used on secured networks; public Wi-Fi must always be
used with the company VPN switched on.
Confidential documents must not be printed at home. Any loss of a device must be reported to the IT Service Desk
within one hour.

Remote and Hybrid Working Policy (HR-POL-012) — 6. Review
This policy is reviewed annually by People Operations. Version 3.0 replaces version 2.1 and takes effect on 15 January
2026.

Travel and Expenses Policy v1.0 (FIN-POL-004-v1) — Preamble
FIN-POL-004 Travel and Expenses Policy (v1.0)
Northwind Talent Ltd | Finance | Version 1.0 | Effective 1 April 2024

Travel and Expenses Policy v1.0 (FIN-POL-004-v1) — 1. Scope
This policy sets out the rules for business travel and expenses at Northwind Talent Ltd. It applies to all employees and to
contractors who are permitted to claim expenses under their contract.

Travel and Expenses Policy v1.0 (FIN-POL-004-v1) — 2. Approval limits
All expense claims must be approved by the employee's line manager. Any single claim above GBP 500 also requires
approval from the budget-holding Director. Claims above GBP 2,500 require CFO approval.
Claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense being incurred.

Travel and Expenses Policy v1.0 (FIN-POL-004-v1) — 3. Hotels
The maximum nightly hotel rate, including taxes, is GBP 150 in London, GBP 110 elsewhere in the UK, EUR 140 in
Amsterdam and INR 7,000 in Bangalore, Chennai or Mumbai. Rates above the cap require prior Director approval.

Travel and Expenses Policy v1.0 (FIN-POL-004-v1) — 4. Meals and subsistence
Employees travelling overnight may claim up to GBP 35 per day for meals. Alcohol is not reimbursable except at
approved client entertainment events.

Travel and Expenses Policy v1.0 (FIN-POL-004-v1) — 5. Rail and air travel
Rail travel should be standard class. First class is allowed for journeys over three hours. Flights under six hours must be
economy class.

Travel and Expenses Policy v1.0 (FIN-POL-004-v1) — 6. Effective date
Version 1.0. Effective from 1 April 2024.

Travel and Expenses Policy v2.0 (FIN-POL-004-v2) — Preamble
FIN-POL-004 Travel and Expenses Policy (v2.0)
Northwind Talent Ltd | Finance | Version 2.0 | Effective 1 April 2026

Travel and Expenses Policy v2.0 (FIN-POL-004-v2) — 1. Scope
This policy sets out the rules for business travel and expenses at Northwind Talent Ltd. It applies to all employees and to
contractors who are permitted to claim expenses under their contract. Version 2.0 replaces version 1.0 in full.

Travel and Expenses Policy v2.0 (FIN-POL-004-v2) — 2. Approval limits
All expense claims must be approved by the employee's line manager. Any single claim above GBP 750 also requires
approval from the budget-holding Director. Claims above GBP 3,000 require CFO approval.
Claims must be submitted within 45 days of the expense being incurred. Late claims are rejected automatically unless
the Finance Controller grants an exception.

Travel and Expenses Policy v2.0 (FIN-POL-004-v2) — 3. Hotels
The maximum nightly hotel rate, including taxes, is GBP 180 in London, GBP 120 elsewhere in the UK, EUR 160 in
Amsterdam and INR 8,500 in Bangalore, Chennai or Mumbai. Bookings must be made through the corporate travel
portal; bookings made elsewhere are only reimbursed up to the cap.

Travel and Expenses Policy v2.0 (FIN-POL-004-v2) — 4. Meals and subsistence
Employees travelling overnight may claim up to GBP 40 per day for meals (EUR 45 in the Netherlands, INR 2,500 in
India). Alcohol is not reimbursable except at approved client entertainment events.

Travel and Expenses Policy v2.0 (FIN-POL-004-v2) — 5. Rail and air travel
Rail travel must be standard class for all journeys. Flights under six hours must be economy class; premium economy is
allowed for flights over six hours.

Travel and Expenses Policy v2.0 (FIN-POL-004-v2) — 6. Effective date
Version 2.0. Effective from 1 April 2026. Changes from version 1.0: higher hotel caps, higher meal allowance, Director
approval threshold raised from GBP 500 to GBP 750, claim window extended to 45 days, and first-class rail removed.

Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — CTR-2025-044 Master Services Agreement — Acme Cloud Ltd
This Master Services Agreement is made between Northwind Talent Ltd ("Northwind") and Acme Cloud Ltd ("Acme Cloud"), effective 1 July 2025.

metadata.title: Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement
metadata.section: CTR-2025-044 Master Services Agreement — Acme Cloud Ltd

text:
Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — 1. Definitions
"Services" means the managed cloud hosting, backup and monitoring services described in Schedule 1. "Monthly Uptime" means the percentage of minutes in a calendar month during which the production environment is available, excluding Planned Maintenance.

Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — 2. Term and renewal
This Agreement starts on 1 July 2025 and continues for an initial term of 36 months. It then renews automatically for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the current term.

Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — 3. Service levels
Acme Cloud shall provide Monthly Uptime of at least 99.9% for the production environment. Planned Maintenance must be notified 5 business days in advance and may not exceed 4 hours per month.

If Monthly Uptime falls below 99.9%, Northwind is entitled to service credits of 5% of the monthly fee for each 0.1% (or part) below the target, capped at 30% of the monthly fee. Service credits must be claimed within 30 days of the end of the affected month.

Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — 4. Data residency and security
All Northwind production data shall be stored and processed only in data centres located in the European Union (Frankfurt, Amsterdam) and India (Mumbai). Acme Cloud shall maintain ISO 27001 certification and notify Northwind of any personal data breach within 24 hours of becoming aware of it.

Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — 5. Fees and payment
Fees are set out in Schedule 2 and are invoiced monthly in arrears. Invoices are payable within 45 days. Fees may be increased once per year by no more than the UK CPI rate plus 2%.

Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — 6. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving at least 90 days' written notice, but not before the first 12 months of the initial term have elapsed. Either party may terminate immediately on written notice if the other party commits a material breach that is not remedied within 30 days.

Northwind may also terminate if Monthly Uptime falls below 99.0% in any three months within a rolling six-month period.

Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — 7. Limitation of liability
Each party's total liability under this Agreement is capped at the total fees paid in the 12 months before the claim. The cap does not apply to breach of confidentiality, data-protection obligations or death and personal injury caused by negligence.

Acme Cloud Master Services Agreement (CTR-2025-044) — 8. Exit assistance
On termination, Acme Cloud shall provide up to 60 days of exit assistance, including a full export of Northwind data in an industry-standard format, at the then-current professional services rates.

Nimbus Payroll Data Processing Agreement (CTR-2026-009) — CTR-2026-009 Data Processing Agreement — Nimbus Payroll Services
This Data Processing Agreement is made between Northwind Talent Ltd and Nimbus Payroll Services Pvt Ltd, effective 1 March 2026.

metadata.title: Nimbus Payroll Data Processing Agreement
metadata.section: CTR-2026-009 Data Processing Agreement — Nimbus Payroll Services

text:
Nimbus Payroll Data Processing Agreement (CTR-2026-009) — 1. Subject matter
Nimbus Payroll Services Pvt Ltd processes employee payroll data on behalf of Northwind Talent Ltd for employees in India and the Netherlands. Northwind is the controller and Nimbus is the processor.

Nimbus Payroll Data Processing Agreement (CTR-2026-009) — 2. Categories of data
Names, employee IDs, bank details, tax identifiers, salary, deductions and statutory benefit information. No special-category data is processed except where required by statutory leave calculations.

Nimbus Payroll Data Processing Agreement (CTR-2026-009) — 3. Location of processing
Payroll data is processed in Nimbus data centres in Chennai and Pune, India, with an encrypted backup in Frankfurt, Germany. Transfers of Netherlands employee data to India are covered by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2) attached as Annex 3.

Nimbus Payroll Data Processing Agreement (CTR-2026-009) — 4. Sub-processors
Nimbus may only appoint sub-processors listed in Annex 2. Northwind must be given 30 days' notice of any new sub-processor and may object on reasonable data-protection grounds.

Nimbus Payroll Data Processing Agreement (CTR-2026-009) — 5. Security and breach notification
Nimbus shall encrypt data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2 or higher), enforce multi-factor authentication for all administrative access and notify Northwind of a personal data breach without undue delay and in any case within 24 hours.

Nimbus Payroll Data Processing Agreement (CTR-2026-009) — 6. Retention and deletion
Payroll records are retained for 8 years after the end of the tax year to which they relate, and then securely deleted. On termination Nimbus shall return all data within 30 days and delete remaining copies within 60 days, providing a deletion certificate.

Remote-access VPN outage runbook (RB-NET-007) — RB-NET-007 — Remote-access VPN outage
**Owner:** Network Operations · **Severity:** P1 when more than 50 users are affected · **Last reviewed:** 10 Nov 2025

Remote-access VPN outage runbook (RB-NET-007) — Symptoms
- Users see *"Error 809: The network connection between your computer and the VPN server could not be established"*.
- GlobalConnect client stuck on "Authenticating…" for more than 60 seconds.
- Spike in Service Desk tickets tagged `vpn`.

Remote-access VPN outage runbook (RB-NET-007) — Triage
1. Check the VPN dashboard in Grafana (`net-vpn-overview`) for gateway CPU and active sessions.
2. Confirm whether the issue affects one region (London, Amsterdam, Bangalore) or all.
3. Check the certificate on gateway `vpn-gw-01`/`vpn-gw-02`: `openssl s_client -connect vpn.northwind.example:443`.
4. If more than 50 users are affected, raise a P1 incident and page the Network on-call.

Remote-access VPN outage runbook (RB-NET-007) — Common causes and fixes > Expired gateway certificate
The most frequent root cause (see INC-4821). Renew the certificate from the internal CA, upload to both gateways and restart the `ike` service. Total time is usually 20 minutes.

metadata.title: Remote-access VPN outage runbook
metadata.section: Common causes and fixes > Expired gateway certificate

text:
Remote-access VPN outage runbook (RB-NET-007) — Common causes and fixes > RADIUS / MFA timeout
If authentication hangs, check the RADIUS proxy `rad-01`. Restart the `freeradius` service and confirm the MFA provider status page. Increase the client timeout to 90 seconds as a temporary workaround.

metadata.title: Remote-access VPN outage runbook
metadata.section: Common causes and fixes > RADIUS / MFA timeout

text:
Remote-access VPN outage runbook (RB-NET-007) — Common causes and fixes > Error 809 on home routers
Error 809 for a single user is usually a home router blocking UDP 500/4500. Ask the user to switch the client to SSL/TCP 443 mode in *Settings → Protocol*.

metadata.title: Remote-access VPN outage runbook
metadata.section: Common causes and fixes > Error 809 on home routers

text:
Remote-access VPN outage runbook (RB-NET-007) — Escalation
Escalate to the Network Lead after 30 minutes without progress on a P1. Communicate status to users every 30 minutes through the IT status page.

Remote-access VPN outage runbook (RB-NET-007) — Post-incident
Raise a problem record, attach the timeline, and update this runbook if a new cause was found.

PostgreSQL primary failover runbook (RB-DB-003) — RB-DB-003 — PostgreSQL primary failover
**Owner:** Platform Engineering · **Applies to:** `pg-core` cluster (Patroni, 3 nodes) · **Last reviewed:** 20 Feb 2026

PostgreSQL primary failover runbook (RB-DB-003) — When to use
Use this runbook when the primary database `pg-core-1` is unavailable for more than 2 minutes and Patroni has **not** failed over automatically, or when a planned switchover is required for maintenance.

PostgreSQL primary failover runbook (RB-DB-003) — Pre-checks
1. Confirm the primary is really down: `patronictl -c /etc/patroni.yml list`.
2. Check replication lag on the replicas; do **not** promote a replica that is more than 30 seconds behind unless the Incident Manager approves data loss.
3. Freeze deployments in the release pipeline.

PostgreSQL primary failover runbook (RB-DB-003) — Promote a replica to primary
1. Run `patronictl -c /etc/patroni.yml failover --candidate pg-core-2`.
2. Confirm the new leader with `patronictl list` — `pg-core-2` must show role `Leader`.
3. The PgBouncer pool picks up the new primary through the Consul service `pg-core-primary`; verify with `psql -h pg-core-primary.service -c "select pg_is_in_recovery();"` which must return `f`.
4. Run the smoke test job `db-smoke` in the CI pipeline.

PostgreSQL primary failover runbook (RB-DB-003) — Rebuild the old primary
Once the old node is healthy, re-initialise it as a replica: `patronictl reinit pg-core pg-core-1`. Monitor replication until lag is under 1 second.

PostgreSQL primary failover runbook (RB-DB-003) — Rollback
If the new primary misbehaves within 15 minutes, switch back with `patronictl switchover --candidate pg-core-1` provided its data is intact.

PostgreSQL primary failover runbook (RB-DB-003) — Communication
Post in `#inc-bridge` at each step. The RPO target for `pg-core` is 30 seconds and the RTO target is 15 minutes.

IT Security FAQ (intranet page) (IT-SEC-FAQ) — IT Security FAQ
Last updated 1 September 2025 by the Information Security team.

IT Security FAQ (intranet page) (IT-SEC-FAQ) — Passwords and multi-factor authentication
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. You do not need to change your password on a schedule,
only when you suspect it has been exposed. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for email,
VPN, the HR portal and all finance systems.

IT Security FAQ (intranet page) (IT-SEC-FAQ) — Passwords and multi-factor authentication > Can I use email on my personal phone?
Yes, through the Outlook app only, enrolled in the company's mobile device management (Intune).
MFA is mandatory on personal phones and the app enforces a 6-digit PIN. Native mail apps are blocked.

metadata.title: IT Security FAQ (intranet page)
metadata.section: Passwords and multi-factor authentication > Can I use email on my personal phone?

text:
IT Security FAQ (intranet page) (IT-SEC-FAQ) — Phishing
If you clicked a link or opened an attachment in a suspicious email, disconnect from the network,
do not enter any more credentials and call the IT Service Desk on extension 4444 immediately. Then
use the Report Phish button in Outlook. Reporting quickly matters more than embarrassment:
there is no penalty for reporting a genuine mistake.

IT Security FAQ (intranet page) (IT-SEC-FAQ) — Lost or stolen devices
Report a lost laptop or phone to the IT Service Desk within one hour. The device will be remotely
locked and wiped. A police reference number is required for stolen devices.

IT Security FAQ (intranet page) (IT-SEC-FAQ) — USB drives and file sharing
USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops. Share files internally through SharePoint and
externally only through the approved secure file transfer service. Personal cloud storage
(e.g. personal Dropbox or Google Drive) must not be used for company data.

IT Security FAQ (intranet page) (IT-SEC-FAQ) — Travelling abroad with a laptop
Inform Information Security before taking a company laptop to a country outside the UK, EU or India.
A loaner laptop may be issued for high-risk destinations.

Incident INC-4821 (P1, vpn)
ticket_id: INC-4821
opened: 2025-11-03
priority: P1
category: vpn
summary: Company-wide VPN outage, users in London and Amsterdam getting Error 809 from 08:40.
resolution: Root cause: TLS certificate on vpn-gw-01 and vpn-gw-02 expired overnight. Certificate renewed from internal CA and ike service restarted at 09:25. Problem record PRB-0192 raised to automate certificate expiry alerts.
related_doc: RB-NET-007

Incident INC-4830 (P3, vpn)
ticket_id: INC-4830
opened: 2025-11-05
priority: P3
category: vpn
summary: Single user in Bangalore cannot connect to VPN from home, Error 809.
resolution: Home router blocking UDP 4500. User switched GlobalConnect to SSL/TCP 443 mode. Resolved.
related_doc: RB-NET-007

Incident INC-4902 (P2, vpn)
ticket_id: INC-4902
opened: 2025-12-12
priority: P2
category: vpn
summary: VPN authentication hanging for about 40 users, stuck on Authenticating.
resolution: RADIUS proxy rad-01 memory exhaustion. freeradius restarted; memory limit raised. Client timeout set to 90s.
related_doc: RB-NET-007

Incident INC-5017 (P1, database)
ticket_id: INC-5017
opened: 2026-01-21
priority: P1
category: database
summary: pg-core-1 primary unreachable after storage controller failure; Patroni did not fail over.
resolution: Manual failover to pg-core-2 per RB-DB-003 at 14:07. Replication lag at promotion was 4 seconds. pg-core-1 reinitialised as replica next day. Total outage 11 minutes, within RTO.
related_doc: RB-DB-003

Incident INC-5033 (P3, laptop)
ticket_id: INC-5033
opened: 2026-02-02
priority: P3
category: laptop
summary: New joiner laptop not receiving Intune policies; Outlook app blocked on personal phone.
resolution: Device was not enrolled in Intune. Re-enrolled; MFA registration completed. Resolved.

Incident INC-5101 (P2, security)
ticket_id: INC-5101
opened: 2026-03-15
priority: P2
category: security
summary: Employee clicked a phishing link imitating the HR portal and entered credentials.
resolution: Account password reset, sessions revoked, MFA re-registered. Phishing domain blocked at the mail gateway. No evidence of data access.

Incident INC-5188 (P3, expenses)
ticket_id: INC-5188
opened: 2026-05-08
priority: P3
category: expenses
summary: Expense claim for London hotel at GBP 175 rejected by system as above cap.
resolution: Claim dated before 1 April 2026 so the old GBP 150 cap applied (FIN-POL-004 v1). Director approval obtained and claim resubmitted.
related_doc: FIN-POL-004

Incident INC-5240 (P2, database)
ticket_id: INC-5240
opened: 2026-06-19
priority: P2
category: database
summary: Planned switchover of pg-core for kernel patching.
resolution: Switchover to pg-core-3 completed in 3 minutes using patronictl switchover. db-smoke passed.
